**AUTOMATIC LIGHT USING LDR**

**Aim**

To design a simple automatic light circuit using a LDR, transistor, LED, and battery. The LED automatically turns ON/OFF depending or the surrounding light intensity

**Principle**

The circuit works on the principle of light-dependent resistance. The resistance of the LDR changes according To the intensity of light, which controls the transistor and LED.

**Working**

Ø  The circuit is powered by a 9V battery  
Ø  The LDR senses the surrounding light intensity  
Ø  When the light level changes, the resistance of the LDR changes.  
Ø  This changes the voltage applied to the transistor.  
Ø  The transistor acts as a switch and controls the LED.  
Ø  Thus, the LED automatically responds to the surrounding light.

**Components Used**

o   LDR (Light Dependent Resistor  
o   NPN Transistor  
o   LED  
o   Resistors  
o   9V Battery  
o   Breadboard  
o   Connecting wires

**Uses Applications**

* Automatic lighting systems    
* Home and room lighting  
* Night lamps  
* Street-light control systems  
* Battery-powered light control  
*  Light-sensitive electronic circuits
